assertions.name: content_monomial_is_half_degree_shape_sum
assertions.source: Content-off statistic = Σ_λ f^λ q^content(λ) (closed form, = enumeration, palindromic, C_n(1)=I(n)); deg n(n-1)/2 = half deg Z_n = n(n-1); slope ratio -> 1/2. Content carries exactly half the q-Gevrey rate — the analytic W9 separation.

description: Lever-1 W12 (z2bn follow-up): analytic separation of the content-monomial contribution to the binding statistic. The W9 descent-scalar-off object is exactly the closed shape sum C_n(q) = Σ_{λ⊢n} f^λ q^content(λ) (RSK: #involutions of shape λ = f^λ) — verified equal to direct involution enumeration (n≤8), palindromic C_n(q)=C_n(1/q), and C_n(1)=I(n). Growth law: deg_q C_n = n(n-1)/2 = EXACTLY HALF deg_q Z_n = n(n-1) (the descent scalar q^(2k) doubles the top degree), so the content part carries half the asymptotic q-Gevrey slope: slope(C_n) -> ln q_0, slope(Z_n) -> 2 ln q_0, ratio -> 1/2 (measured at q_0, n≤70 via the direct partition sum). This is the analytic form of W9's descent-dominant/content-secondary decomposition: content is not vanishing but exactly the 'square root' of the full growth. Exact sympy + 50-dps mpmath; no fit; no wiring; EXPLORATORY.
